intro: Farrer Park Fields is an HDB project in Kallang/Whampoa, in the Farrer Park area. As with Farrer Park Arena, a third-party completion estimate is on file and is not officially confirmed. HDB has not verified a project-wide completion or key month, and tracker sources have disagreed, so unit counts and any estimated month are left out of the facts below. The word “Fields” is not treated as a confirmed outlook. Use your HDB key letter, if you have one, as the source of truth. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Farrer Park Fields renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Farrer Park Fields interior
sections.text:
A Farrer Park flat is usually a long-stay home in a busy, inner-city setting, which is why the first fit-out is worth doing properly rather than as a temporary arrangement of loose furniture. Maison would start, once the approved plan is in hand, with a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, and we can work in closer shots of materials as well as a wide room view. We do not use flat-pack furniture as the backbone of the home. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Farrer Park Fields layout or copy one from Farrer Park Arena.

Towner Residences, Kent Heights and Verandah @ Kallang are the other Kallang/Whampoa pages on this site; Dorset Gardens is a nearby District 8 link. None of them is a typologies or key-date reference for this project. We will not invent walking times to Farrer Park MRT, and we will not assign a park or stadium view from the name. Check facing, road noise and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds or a window bench.

After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.q: Do you have the Farrer Park Fields floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved HDB unit plan.

faq.q: Do I need an HDB renovation permit?
faq.a: Yes, for the usual HDB renovation works. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the permit with a registered contractor before carpentry is fabricated.
Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
